issue.body:
## Observed artifact mismatch

The first published logger primary-failure artifact redacted personal home paths after retaining original output hashes.
The public text was therefore not always the byte sequence described by its adjacent original byte count and SHA-256.

For `package.pi-plugin.auto-mode.test.unit`,
the original output contains 137798 bytes;
the retained redacted text contains 137763 bytes.
The artifact checker rejected `137763 !== 137798`.
This was a published evidence-construction defect,
not a provider result or application-source change.

## Exercised correction

Commit `0825ca672a` separates original output provenance from retained public text in
`doc/audit/depot-logger-primary-failures-2026-10-17.evidence.json`.
Every row now records original byte count and hash,
verification before redaction,
retained text byte count and hash,
and whether personal home paths were redacted.

All 105 private original files were rehashed against their original observation records.
All 105 public retained texts independently pass their own byte-count and SHA-256 checks.
One row changes under home-path redaction.
Original outputs total 10496598 bytes;
retained public texts total 10496563 bytes.

## Resolution boundary

The corrected artifact and its actual consumer checker pass.
The final evaluation distinguishes original hashes from retained-text hashes.
This closes the verified schema error for this artifact only.
It makes no claim that every older artifact or every future redaction path has been audited.

Tracking marker: `depot-primary-retained-output-digest-20261017`.
